newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain-high wage rises have negative growth impact.
newsitem.headline: Spain-high wage rises have negative growth impact.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Monday that excessive wage rises could have a negative impact on Spanish growth in coming years.
"(Wages increase in a few sectors) are posing a risk for the economic growth we currently have in Spain," Montoro told reporters after a seminar in Madrid.
He added that a more moderate trend in wages would help boost employment and growth.
Earlier on Monday national statistic institute INE reported that wages rose 4.2 percent year on year in the first quarter.
He added that the government is studying which sectors are the ones where there are more upward pressures. He is expected to present the results next Monday to a parliamentary committee.
"The government is looking at which sectors have wages increases which do not reflect our economic situation," he said.
